queries.name: rom
queries.description: Range of motion on sagittal plane.
queries.calculation: rom = max(values) - min(values); return min, max, rom

queries.name: peak_flexion
queries.description: Maximum flexion angle on sagittal plane.
queries.calculation: peak = max(values)

queries.name: peak_extension
queries.description: Maximum extension angle on sagittal plane.
queries.calculation: peak = min(values)

queries.name: peak_timing
queries.description: Timing of the max/min peak (frame index and seconds).
queries.calculation: index_of_peak = argmax or argmin; time_s = index / fps

queries.name: rom_frontal
queries.description: Range of motion on frontal plane.
queries.calculation: rom = max(values) - min(values); return min, max, rom

queries.name: rom_transverse
queries.description: Range of motion on transverse plane.
queries.calculation: rom = max(values) - min(values); return min, max, rom

queries.name: angular_velocity
queries.description: Angular velocity for a joint on the selected plane.
queries.calculation: velocity = d(angle)/dt; return peak_positive, peak_negative, mean_abs

queries.name: angular_acceleration
queries.description: Angular acceleration for a joint on the selected plane.
queries.calculation: acceleration = d²(angle)/dt²; return peak_positive, peak_negative, mean_abs

queries.name: angular_impulse
queries.description: Integral of the joint angle over time.
queries.calculation: impulse = ∫ angle dt

queries.name: phase_profile
queries.description: Angle profile over a selected phase range (e.g., stance).
queries.calculation: return angle series over the selected phase range

queries.name: phase_profile
queries.description: Angle profile over a selected phase range (e.g., swing).
queries.calculation: return angle series over the selected phase range

queries.name: cycle_samples
queries.description: Sample angles at standard cycle percentiles.
queries.calculation: interpolate angle values at requested percentiles

queries.name: relative_phase
queries.description: Continuous relative phase between two joints.
queries.calculation: phase = atan2(velocity, angle); diff = phase_a - phase_b

queries.name: angle_angle_curve
queries.description: Angle-angle curve between two joints.
queries.calculation: return paired angle series

queries.name: movement_variability
queries.description: Variability across cycles using resampled profiles.
queries.calculation: std profile across cycles

queries.name: symmetry_index
queries.description: Left-right symmetry index for a metric.
queries.calculation: SI = 1 - |L-R| / mean(|L|,|R|)

queries.name: compare_sports
queries.description: Compare a metric across sports using metadata.
queries.calculation: aggregate metric per sport, compare means

queries.name: compare_sessions
queries.description: Compare a metric across sessions.
queries.calculation: compute metric for each session, report deltas

queries.name: chain_stability
queries.description: Stability of a joint chain based on summed angles.
queries.calculation: range of summed chain angles, compare to tolerance

queries.name: gesture_detection
queries.description: Detect threshold-based gestures with minimum duration.
queries.calculation: threshold crossings with duration constraint
